interface.longDescription:
Glop is a point-of-sale (POS) system for restaurants, bars and retail shops. This plugin connects ChatGPT to the Glop POS of your business so you can query and manage its data in conversation.

What you can do:
- Sales: revenue by day, hour, shift, employee, product family or location; best-selling products; cash vs. card; comparisons between periods.
- Purchases: spending by supplier, most purchased items and how supplier prices change over time.
- Stock: current stock levels by item and warehouse.
- Supplier delivery notes: read a photo or PDF of a delivery note, match the supplier and items, and register it in the POS after you confirm.
- Reports for your accountant with the sales and VAT of a period.

Who it is for: owners and managers of businesses that use Glop as their POS. You sign in with your Glop account.

Limitations: it only accesses the data of the business you sign in with; it never writes to the POS (delivery notes, items, suppliers) without your explicit confirmation; and it cannot see the physical cash in the drawer or the tables that are open right now.
